component.name: Tetia
component.summary: Library for manga, images and video

description.p: Tetia keeps your manga, pictures and videos in one place: browse collections, tag and rate what is in them, and find anything with a single search box.

ul.li: Collections of folders for photos, videos, manga and books, with covers and nested subfolders
Tags in five categories, ratings and favorites, with bulk tagging by click or drag selection
One search box for tags and file names, across the whole library or inside a folder
Moved and renamed files keep their tags and favorites
Private profiles with their own library, optionally encrypted in a KDE Plasma Vault

screenshot.caption: Search tags and file names across every collection
Tag your files by category and set a content rating
Browse a folder of images as a thumbnail grid
Read manga and PDF volumes with cover thumbnails
Keep your favorite collections and books in one place
View images full screen with arrow-key navigation
